purpose: Offline face detection and feature comparison research for D2 on RDK X5; no camera or biometric enrollment was accessed during preparation.
commit_resolution: Read-only git ls-remote https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo.git refs/heads/main. GitHub unauthenticated commit API was rate-limited; no commit date is asserted.

models.variant_reason: Full unquantized2023mar model selected for existing OpenCV4.11 DNN; no OpenCV5-only engine assumptions or int8 quantized variant.

models.role: aligned face embedding and feature comparison

minimal_opencv411_api_configuration.detector_input: BGR uint8 image,320x320. Preserve aspect ratio by letterboxing, and retain scale/padding so bounding box and five landmark coordinates can be mapped back to the original BGR frame.
minimal_opencv411_api_configuration.detection_result: retval, faces = detector.detect(detector_bgr); require exactly one accepted face for initial authentication experiments.
minimal_opencv411_api_configuration.align_crop: aligned = recognizer.alignCrop(original_bgr, face_row_in_original_coordinates); OpenCV4.11 source uses warpAffine output Size(112,112).
minimal_opencv411_api_configuration.feature: embedding = recognizer.feature(aligned); keep distinct query and enrolled feature copies if reusing recognizer outputs.
minimal_opencv411_api_configuration.match: score = recognizer.match(query_embedding, enrolled_embedding, cv2.FaceRecognizerSF_FR_COSINE); larger cosine scores indicate more similar embeddings.

experimental_threshold_suggestion_not_va.reset_conditions: Reset the matching streak on face absence, multiple faces, stale/repeated capture, invalid depth/quality or any score below the chosen threshold. Count distinct actual captures, not repeated UI samples of the same frame.
experimental_threshold_suggestion_not_va.status: These are conservative research starting values chosen for trial, not calibrated acceptance thresholds or a quantified security guarantee. No data from this user, this D2 or the X5 scene was used to validate them.
experimental_threshold_suggestion_not_va.benchmark_warning: The official SFace wrapper includes cosine0.363 and norm-L2 1.128 benchmark/demo thresholds. They were not adopted as authentication security thresholds. Increasing threshold or checking consecutive correlated frames does not establish spoof resistance or a false-accept rate.
experimental_threshold_suggestion_not_va.calibration_needed: Evaluate genuine-user scores across expected pose/lighting and nonmatching identities with explicit consent before setting a deployed threshold; enforce quality/liveness evidence separately and preserve the authorized PIN path.

passed: Both full model byte lengths and SHA256 digests exactly match their official commit-pinned Git LFS declarations.
Model binary prefixes differ from Git LFS pointer text; complete payloads were downloaded.
Each complete upstream model-directory license was saved and hashed.
OpenCV4.11 official API and alignment source were read to confirm constructor arguments and112x112 alignCrop output.
not_performed: Model load/inference on X5 or Windows. The local bundled Python has neither cv2 nor onnx, and no additional package was installed.
Face enrollment, face photography, camera access, SSH access, user/nonmatching identity tests, accuracy/FAR/spoof evaluation or runtime performance measurement.
validation.privacy_scope: No third-party face dataset or user face photographs were downloaded. Only official model payloads, license texts and LFS provenance records are present.
